justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/Code128Reader.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/MultiFormatOneDReader.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/Code128Writer.java, and core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/oned/Code128WriterTestCase.java. Code128Reader has normal decoder dependencies (it extends OneDReader and imports BarcodeFormat, ChecksumException, DecodeHintType, FormatException, NotFoundException, Result, ResultMetadataType, ResultPoint, and BitArray), but source-level fan-in is small: only MultiFormatOneDReader instantiates it in production code (lines 63-84), Code128Writer reuses its CODE_PATTERNS table (lines 238, 255, 258), and one test creates it (lines 54-59).
